title: Loop gain, phase margin and gain margin across the DR-002 C_out/ESR window (0-50mA)
claim: Substantiates spec/target-spec.md's DRAFT "Stability" row (stable 0-50 mA over the ratified C_out/ESR window; PM >= 45 deg, GM >= 10 dB worst corner) against the issue-#25 current-mirror-OTA revision of the LDO core-regulation loop (design/ldo_3v3in_1v8out.sch). Both the spec row and the window are DRAFT/proposed -- the row awaits issue #1 and the window is DR-002's *proposed* C_eff 0.33-4.7 uF / ESR 0-500 mOhm / no-minimum-ESR posture -- so the bounds below cite them directly rather than an invented final limit, and need re-verification once #1 rules. This is also the testbench DR-002 sequenced itself in front of: DR-002 states its no-minimum-ESR posture stays an unverified claim 'until a loop-gain sim/ record exists', and names the low-C_eff/low-ESR corner as the one that has to be shown. Method: closed-loop injection at VREF with the loop gain recovered as T = X/(1-X), X = v(xldo.fb) -- see the testbench schematic's header for the derivation, and for the one approximation it makes (input-pair path asymmetry, a fraction of a degree at these crossovers).
statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix check, not a distribution claim)

measurements.name: pm_c033_50ma_deg
measurements.note: Phase margin at DR-002's low-C_eff corner: C_out 0.33uF, ESR 10mOhm, 50mA. This is the specific corner issue #25 was told to re-check -- the candidate fix screened during #22 showed a 351mV pp limit cycle here. DRAFT bound: spec/target-spec.md "Stability" row, PM >= 45 deg worst corner.

measurements.name: gm_c033_50ma_db
measurements.note: Gain margin at the same low-C_eff corner. DRAFT bound: spec/target-spec.md "Stability" row, GM >= 10 dB worst corner.

measurements.name: fc_c033_50ma_hz
measurements.note: Unity-loop-gain crossover frequency at the low-C_eff corner. Reported, not bounded: the DRAFT spec states no bandwidth row. It is the number C_COMP/R_CZ were actually sized against (crossover has to stay below the pass stage's own gm_pass/(2*pi*C_out) pole across the window).

measurements.name: dcgain_c033_50ma_db
measurements.note: DC loop gain at the low-C_eff corner (evaluated at the sweep's 0.01Hz start point). Reported, not bounded: the DRAFT spec bounds load/line regulation and output accuracy, not loop gain directly.

measurements.name: pm_c033_1ma_deg
measurements.note: Phase margin at C_out 0.33uF, ESR 10mOhm, 1mA. DRAFT bound: "Stability" row, PM >= 45 deg.

measurements.name: pm_c033_0ma_deg
measurements.note: Phase margin at C_out 0.33uF, ESR 10mOhm, 0mA (feedback divider is the only preload). DRAFT bound: "Stability" row, PM >= 45 deg. Screening at tt/27C says this is the binding point of the whole window -- see design/README.md "Compensation (sized in #25)" and the DR-002 append for why, and for why it is a low-frequency pole/zero doublet dip (gain margin stays very large) rather than a near-oscillation.

measurements.name: gm_c033_0ma_db
measurements.note: Gain margin at the 0mA / 0.33uF point. Recorded alongside pm_c033_0ma_deg specifically because the two tell different stories there: the phase dips into a doublet while the gain is still tens of dB from unity. DRAFT bound: "Stability" row, GM >= 10 dB.

measurements.name: pm_c47_50ma_deg
measurements.note: Phase margin at C_out 4.7uF (DR-002's C_eff ceiling), ESR 10mOhm, 50mA. DRAFT bound: "Stability" row, PM >= 45 deg.

measurements.name: pm_c47_1ma_deg
measurements.note: Phase margin at C_out 4.7uF, ESR 10mOhm, 1mA. DRAFT bound: "Stability" row, PM >= 45 deg.

measurements.name: pm_c47_0ma_deg
measurements.note: Phase margin at C_out 4.7uF, ESR 10mOhm, 0mA. DRAFT bound: "Stability" row, PM >= 45 deg.

measurements.name: pm_c033_esr500m_50ma_deg
measurements.note: Phase margin at DR-002's ESR ceiling: C_out 0.33uF, ESR 500mOhm, 50mA. Included to show which end of the ESR range is the stressing one -- DR-002's posture is 'no minimum ESR', so the low-ESR end (points 1-6) is where the loop has no ESR zero to lean on. DRAFT bound: "Stability" row, PM >= 45 deg.
